caption: The drawing features four rectangular sections arranged vertically on a blank, light beige background. Each section is labeled with a blue number, "1." through "4.", placed to the left of each rectangle. The second section (2) contains a slightly more complex grid, also in pencil or gray ink, with some extra markings or patterns filling the squares. The third section (3) is a colored grid, where the rectangles are filled with alternating pink and blue patterns, creating a repetitive design. The fourth section (4) is the most densely colored, with the rectangles filled with repeated patterns in saturated red-brown and blue colors, arranged in alternating horizontal bands.
